name: certified_exchange_residual_floor
rule: (4*(weight+conflict_weight+compatible_weight) if weight >= neighbor_cover else 0) + weight + residual_pack - 0.25*max(0,residual_cover-residual_pack) - 0.35*max(0,neighbor_pack-weight) + 0.15*boundary_weight/(1+degree) + 0.05*neighbor_edge_weight/(1+degree) - 0.02*weight*degree/(1+degree)
rationale: Both parents are identical: their backbone estimates completion on the compatible residual using greedy packing and clique covering, discounts independent opportunities among blocked neighbors, and rewards neighborhood and boundary conflicts. This variant first prioritizes a local exchange certificate: if root weight reaches the active neighborhood's clique-cover upper bound, replacing any selected neighbor set by the root cannot lose weight. Otherwise, it favors the feasible residual packing floor and penalizes the pack-cover uncertainty gap instead of rewarding optimism. Weighted boundary and internal conflict relief refine the ranking while keeping its scale consistent with vertex weights. Every structural set is restricted to current availability.
